description: This file defines a React component for the exam mode page in a web application. It includes a static parameter generator function and an asynchronous component that fetches route parameters and renders the ExamModeClient component within a Suspense fallback.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Generates static parameters for the exam mode page, including a hardcoded moduleId for static site generation.

methods.name: ExamModePage
methods.description: Asynchronously renders the exam mode page component, fetching route parameters and wrapping the ExamModeClient within Suspense for fallback loading UI.
